messages:
sasha: CI alert: PR #8123 microbench failed threshold on kv_cache_hit microperf. 7.4% p50 latency regression, ~12% evictions. Rolling rollout blocked until we triage. Logs: https://ci/reports/2060123456

bench-bot: [CI] Threshold diff detected for pr/8123. metric=kv_cache_hit_rate (-0.12), p50_latency +7.4% (compare: baseline=8.9ms new=9.56ms). Full diff and artifacts: https://ci/reports/2060123456/diff

mike: Repro locally? I ran `pytest -k microperf_kv` and saw the same p50 shift on my M60. Quick table from my run:
```
Name                 Old    New    Delta
kv_cache_hit_rate    0.89   0.77   -0.12
p50_latency_ms       8.9    9.56   +0.66
kv_evictions/min     3.2    3.6    +0.4
```

anita: Possible suspects: the kernel-autoselect heuristic merge (commit 9a1f3c) and the batcher hysteresis tweak (commit cbed4a). Both touched kernel_selector.go and kv_cache.go in the same window. They could interact nonlinearly.

lucas: I kicked off a bisect across the PR series. Narrowed initial suspect range to 9a1f3c..cbed4a. Early bisect points to commit 0c3b2f as producing the bulk of the delta. 0c3b2f changes KV prefetch window and disables prefix caching for short sequences.

zhen: If 0c3b2f disables prefix caching for short sequences that could explain the hit-rate drop and higher eviction churn. Can you paste the profiler flamegraph snippet where the time went?

lucas: flamegraph shows hotspot chain: `kv_cache::evict_hot_keys -> prefetch_window_expand -> copy_kv_entries`. The heavy node is `copy_kv_entries` (memcpy heavy) after the prefetch loop expanded.

anita: That makes sense: kernel-autoselect sometimes picks a kernel variant that does not support zero-copy KV views, so we end up copying out entries. The new prefetch window increases the copy volume. Interaction is plausible.

sasha: Proposed action plan: (1) open revert for 0c3b2f and run the microbench CI (2) add a regression guard in microperf asserting kv_cache_hit_rate drop <= 5% vs baseline (3) run a full bisect on canary fleet nodes to validate behavior under realistic sequences. Hold the rollout until results are green. Any objections?

mike: No objections — I'll prepare revert PR and include a short perf test.

bench-bot: Revert PR created: https://git/reverts/2060123456 (revert 0c3b2f). CI re-run queued.

sasha: Thanks everyone — I'll coordinate with releases to hold the canary. Please paste any further local repros here. :thumbsup:
